# Discovery AI Index

Discovery AI Index is an evidence-first public catalog of discoveries materially enabled by AI across medicine, science, mathematics, and technology.

## Editorial policy

- Public records are either `verified` or `under_review`.
- Candidate records remain private until editorial review starts.
- Each record names the AI system's role and links to the strongest available primary source.
- `verified` means a meaningful external check is documented; it does not mean every possible consequence has been replicated.

## Public pages

- Home: https://www.discoveryindex.arclabshq.com/
- Method: https://www.discoveryindex.arclabshq.com/method
- About: https://www.discoveryindex.arclabshq.com/about
- Machine-readable registry: https://www.discoveryindex.arclabshq.com/api/registry
